business_processes.process_description: Complete workflow for user login, session creation, and session management. Ensures only authorized users access the system while maintaining seamless user experience through persistent sessions.

process_steps.step_description: System validates username and password against stored credentials. Failed attempts are tracked to prevent brute-force attacks.
process_steps.business_rationale: Ensures only authorized users access the system and protects against automated password guessing attacks
process_steps.stakeholder_value: Protects customer data and prevents unauthorized access while allowing legitimate users to authenticate

decision_points.false_path: Increment failed attempt counter, return error to user

decision_points.true_path: Lock account for 15 minutes (AUTH-BR-001), notify user

process_steps.step_description: Upon successful validation, system creates secure session token with expiration time and stores in session database
process_steps.business_rationale: Enables stateful user interactions without re-authentication for each request
process_steps.stakeholder_value: Improves user experience through persistent login sessions while maintaining security

process_steps.step_description: System monitors session validity, handles timeouts (30 minutes inactivity), and manages session renewal
process_steps.business_rationale: Balances security (automatic logout of inactive sessions) with usability (session renewal on activity)
process_steps.stakeholder_value: Protects inactive sessions from unauthorized use while minimizing user re-authentication burden

business_processes.process_owner: IT Security Department and Authentication Services Team

business_processes.process_description: Workflow for password policy enforcement, password validation, hashing, and secure storage

process_steps.step_description: System validates password meets minimum complexity requirements (8+ characters, uppercase, lowercase, number, special character)
process_steps.business_rationale: Enforces strong password policy to prevent easy-to-guess passwords
process_steps.stakeholder_value: Protects customer accounts from unauthorized access due to weak passwords

process_steps.step_description: System hashes password using bcrypt algorithm before storing in database. Original password never stored in plaintext.
process_steps.business_rationale: Protects passwords even if database is compromised
process_steps.stakeholder_value: Ensures customer credentials remain secure even in breach scenarios

business_processes.process_description: Workflow for loading user profile data after successful authentication

process_steps.step_description: System retrieves user profile data (name, email, preferences) from database using authenticated user ID
process_steps.business_rationale: Provides personalized user experience based on user-specific data
process_steps.stakeholder_value: Enables customized interface and user-specific features

process_dependencies.dependency_description: Password must be validated and hashed before authentication can verify it
process_dependencies.business_rationale: Password validation ensures only compliant passwords are accepted, authentication verifies them

process_dependencies.dependency_description: User profile loads after session is established
process_dependencies.business_rationale: Valid session required to access user-specific data and prevent unauthorized profile access
